_comment: Canonical step registry for the resolve-issue pipeline. Single source of truth for the step SKELETON (id, order, label, component, gate, runsTests). resolve-issue-dashboard reads this to render its pipeline and to flag cross-run test contention; resolve-issue's SKILL.md is the registry of record for these ids and must stay consistent with it. Per-step BEHAVIOUR lives in resolve-issue/SKILL.md prose, not here. The id prefixes (A/B) and resolve-issue's Phase A/Phase B narrative are the same split around plan approval; the dashboard renders steps as a flat numbered list and does not show the phase letter. runsTests marks steps that execute integration tests against the shared host container stack (Podman + SQL + Azurite); resolve-issue-dashboard warns when two or more runs sit on such a step at once. Adding a step: append it here (resolve-issue-dashboard picks it up) and document its behaviour in resolve-issue/SKILL.md.
